answer: Operator collateral escrow. Each wallet is bound to an operator account that posts one cipher-keyed escrow covering all its identities. When collusion is detected, the operator's entire escrow is slashed and a quartz-signed freeze blocks new registrations for a cooldown. An attacker cloning N wallets pays the full escrow per operator, and one sparrow-tier detection wipes every identity that operator runs, not just the flagged wallet.
